default.summary: llm-d-router's built-in config, used when a run names none: queue depth, KV cache and prefix scorers, then the highest score.
default.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: queue-scorer
- type: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: metrics-data-source
- type: core-metrics-extractor
schedulingProfiles:
- name: default
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: kv-cache-utilization-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 3

pd-always.summary: Disaggregated: every request prefills on the prefill pool, then decodes on the decode pool.
pd-always.yaml:
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: approx-prefix-cache-producer
  parameters:
    maxPrefixTokensToMatch: 16384
    lruCapacityPerServer: 31250
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: queue-scorer
- type: prefill-filter
- type: decode-filter
- type: max-score-picker
- type: always-disagg-pd-decider
- type: disagg-profile-handler
  parameters:
    deciders:
      prefill: always-disagg-pd-decider
schedulingProfiles:
- name: prefill
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: prefill-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1
- name: decode
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: decode-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1

setup.script:
# the stack that priced this report (needs git and Go)
git clone --branch v0.15.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/inference-sim.git inference-sim && \
  { test "$(git -C inference-sim rev-parse HEAD)" = 762f1605ff27cd825d6b2cb2d9e991cd4b864c91 || { echo "inference-sim: v0.15.0 moved off 762f1605, stopping" >&2; false; }; } && \
  (cd inference-sim && go build -o blis main.go) && \
  export PATH="$PWD/inference-sim:$PATH"

git clone --branch 0.5.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-catalog.git blis-catalog && \
  { test "$(git -C blis-catalog rev-parse HEAD)" = b5550f750cb51571498577fbdc1c68f78cda67db || { echo "blis-catalog: 0.5.0 moved off b5550f75, stopping" >&2; false; }; } && \
  export BLIS_CATALOG="$PWD/blis-catalog"

git clone --branch v0.3.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-registry.git blis-registry && \
  { test "$(git -C blis-registry rev-parse HEAD)" = 96bead697172ab7f2cf8346e04e65b837014d867 || { echo "blis-registry: v0.3.0 moved off 96bead69, stopping" >&2; false; }; } && \
  export BLIS_REGISTRY="$PWD/blis-registry"

# the commands run from this repo: router configs live here, scenarios/ is where you save each scenario
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/inference-sim/blis-config-search.git && cd blis-config-search && mkdir -p scenarios
setup.sweep:
# in the blis-config-search checkout, after the install script
python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install pyyaml
python3 -I scripts/run_experiment.py reports/kimi-k2-5-h200-multidoc-pd/spec.yaml --dry-run --catalog "$BLIS_CATALOG"
python3 -I scripts/run_experiment.py reports/kimi-k2-5-h200-multidoc-pd/spec.yaml \
  --blis "$(command -v blis)" --catalog "$BLIS_CATALOG" --registry "$BLIS_REGISTRY" \
  --out repro/

spec_yaml:
name: kimi-k2-5-h200-multidoc-pd
scenario:
  model: kimi-k2.5
  hardware: h200
  workload: multidoc
  gpus: 64
  slo:
    itl_p99: 20ms
    ttft_p99: 5s
  concurrency:
  - 8
  - 16
  - 32
  - 64
  - 128
sweeps:
- name: colocated
  narrative: The colocated control should hold ITL only with a chunked-prefill cap,
    and the wide-dp shapes should give the most tokens per GPU.
  num-instances:
  - 4
  - 8
  parallel:
    tp:
    - 2
    - 4
    - 8
    - 16
    dp:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 4
    enable_expert_parallel:
    - true
  engine:
    max_num_batched_tokens:
    - 8192
    - 32768
    long_prefill_token_threshold:
    - 0
    - 1024
    - 4096
- name: pd-dp1
  narrative: Prefill-heavy ratios should win on 10k prompts, and a threshold near
    the median prompt should beat splitting every request.
  prefill-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  - 3
  - 4
  - 5
  decode-instances:
  - 2
  - 3
  - 4
  - 5
  - 6
  prefill:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 16
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
    engine:
      max_num_batched_tokens:
      - 8192
      - 32768
  decode:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 16
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
    engine:
      long_prefill_token_threshold:
      - 0
      - 1024
  router:
    endpoint_picker_config:
    - pd-prefix.yaml
    plugins:
      prefix-based-pd-decider:
        parameters:
          nonCachedTokens:
          - 256
          - 10240
          - 12288
- name: pd-always
  narrative: Splitting every request should cost ITL headroom against the threshold
    arms, because each handoff stalls a decode slot.
  prefill-instances:
  - 1
  - 2
  - 3
  - 4
  - 5
  decode-instances:
  - 2
  - 3
  - 4
  - 5
  - 6
  prefill:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 16
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
    engine:
      max_num_batched_tokens:
      - 8192
      - 32768
  decode:
    parallel:
      tp:
      - 8
      - 16
      enable_expert_parallel:
      - true
  router:
    endpoint_picker_config:
    - pd-always.yaml

sweeps.name: colocated
sweeps.narrative: The colocated control should hold ITL only with a chunked-prefill cap, and the wide-dp shapes should give the most tokens per GPU.

sweeps.name: pd-dp1
sweeps.narrative: Prefill-heavy ratios should win on 10k prompts, and a threshold near the median prompt should beat splitting every request.

sweeps.name: pd-always
sweeps.narrative: Splitting every request should cost ITL headroom against the threshold arms, because each handoff stalls a decode slot.
